curves.name: Typical instantaneous forward characteristics, Ta = 25 degC
Typical junction capacitance versus reverse voltage

extraction_notes: The reverse-leakage table also specifies IR1 maximum 30 nA at VR = 25 V; reverse_current records the rated VR = 75 V row (IR2, 1.0 uA maximum).

The p. 1 Maximum Ratings table lists Reverse Breakdown voltage @ IR = 100 uA, symbol V(BR)R, as 75 V. This is a ratings-table entry with only a test current, not a guaranteed minimum or measured typical breakdown row, and it equals the separate 75 V VRRM rating, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are omitted.

Curve points were digitized from the Ta = 25 degC traces of Fig. 1 (forward, IF axis in mA), Fig. 2 (reverse, IR axis in nA), and Fig. 3 (capacitance, CT axis in pF); all values are converted to SI units (A, F) in this JSON without interpolation.
Fig. 4 is a thermal power-derating curve and was not extracted as an electrical characteristic.
The datasheet title spelling 'FAST SWITHING DIODES' is preserved verbatim from the source header.
